supporting_ids: s2:A High Time Resolution All-Sky Monitor for Fast Radio Bursts and Technosignature
rationale: The direct candidates (s2:A High Time Resolution All-Sky Monitor for Fast Radio Bursts and Technosignature, 2505.15204, 2408.12200, 2410.13561) contribute new evidence regarding the detection and characterization of FRBs, particularly at low frequencies and with high time resolution, which is relevant to understanding their short-term and low-level variability.
